steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 47
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
You can pay in twelve installments.
There's a 20% discount on shoes today.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia

steps.title: Gramática: Passive Voice
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Passive Voice"?
options: If I were you, I would study more.
The book was written by her.

steps.title: Idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
steps.text: It means: "To be very expensive.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: That car cost an arm and a leg.
